The un-nested control passing in both legs is what pins the red to the NESTING. Real-corpus reading byte-identical before/after (257 examples / 99 files). Changeset patch matches the four prior precedents on this same gate (no skip label needed). Clause-②: no. Out-of-scope finding #11690 (fence-closer disagreement, latent) verified filed, correctly unqueued.
